name: zsys_detect_is_80286_by_eflags_hi_bits
description: zSys::DetectIs80286ByEflagsHiBits checks whether FLAGS high bits clear like a 80286-class CPU.
known_limits: The runtime smoke runs on a CPUID-capable host and does not force the no-CPUID fallback branch.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b35a0 validates saving FLAGS, attempting to set high bits, testing whether they clear, returning 2 for the 80286 match case and 0xffff otherwise, and restoring FLAGS.
Native smoke zsys_runtime_probe_leaves_smoke verifies the caller-visible CPU-class probe path remains plausible on the runtime CPU.
tier_s_evidence: 2026-06-05: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b35a0 passed under vc5_zsys_cpu_raw_asm with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
